description: Use this when the user asks about a Japanese grammar pattern or particle (〜てもいい, ために, ば vs たら, は and が), what it means, how it is used, an example of it, or how to say something with a pattern. Searches the site’s 828 grammar points (N5–N1) by the pattern in Japanese or romaji, or by its meaning in the user’s language. Each result has the pattern, JLPT level, meaning in the user’s language, an example sentence with translation, a recording of the example where available, and the grammar page; plus the site’s course lessons whose titles match, with links and whether each is free or needs a subscription or pass.

lang.description: The user’s language for meanings, labels and links: zh-Hans (Simplified Chinese), zh-Hant (Traditional Chinese), en (English) or ko (Korean). Other languages: en. Default: guessed from the query.

limit.description: How many grammar points to return at most.

query.description: The pattern (てもいい, 〜ために, te mo ii) or what it expresses in the user’s language (permission, “in order to”, 为了).

name: find_grammar

free.description: false: needs a subscription or pass

audio.description: Recordings of the site’s two voices, or null when there is none

url.description: The grammar point on its page

title: Find a Japanese grammar point
